Artisanal Coffee & Premium Tea Blends

Our Menu

Discover our carefully crafted selection of artisanal coffees and premium teas from around the world.

Coffee Selection

Rwandan Bourbon

2,500 RWF

A smooth, well-balanced coffee with notes of citrus and chocolate, grown in the volcanic soils of Rwanda.

Hot/Iced 12oz / 16oz

Espresso

Single/Double 1oz / 2oz

Cappuccino

Regular/Large 8oz / 12oz

Hot/Iced 12oz / 16oz

Hot/Iced 12oz / 16oz

Pastries & Snacks

Croissant

Banana Bread

2,000 RWF

Moist homemade banana bread with walnuts, served warm.

Muffin

2,200 RWF

Daily selection of blueberry, chocolate, or bran muffins.

Avocado Toast

4,500 RWF

Sourdough bread with smashed avocado, cherry tomatoes, and chili flakes.

Fruit Salad

3,500 RWF

Seasonal fresh fruits with optional yogurt and honey.

Cheese Sandwich

4,800 RWF

Grilled sandwich with local cheese, tomatoes, and herbs.

Our Story

Founded in 2018 in the heart of Rwanda, Coffee & Tea began as a small passion project between two friends who shared a love for quality beverages and community spaces.

We source our coffee beans directly from Rwandan farmers in the volcanic regions, ensuring fair trade practices and supporting local agriculture. Our teas are carefully selected from the finest gardens around the world.

What started as a modest café has grown into a beloved gathering place where people come not just for exceptional drinks, but for the warm atmosphere and sense of connection.

5+
Years in Business
12
Local Farmers
50+
Happy Employees

Our Café in Rutsiro

Visit us at our flagship location in Bwiza, Rutsiro

Meet Our Team

Anne Dukundimana

Founder & Head Barista

Anne's passion for coffee began during her travels through East Africa's coffee regions. She oversees our coffee sourcing and barista training.

Noela

Tea Specialist

Noela curates our tea selection and develops unique blends. Her knowledge of tea traditions from around the world is unparalleled.

Jean Paul

Pastry Chef

Jean Paul brings French pastry techniques to Rwandan ingredients, creating our delicious selection of baked goods.

Contact Us

Get in Touch

Location

Bwiza Center, Rutsiro
Rwanda

Email

annedukundimana@gmail.com

Phone

+250 79 *******

Opening Hours

Monday - Friday: 7:00 AM - 8:00 PM
Saturday: 8:00 AM - 9:00 PM
Sunday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM

Follow Us

Why Choose Us

Premium Ingredients

We source only the finest coffee beans and tea leaves, working directly with local Rwandan farmers and international suppliers who share our commitment to quality.

Expert Preparation

Our baristas undergo rigorous training to master both traditional techniques and innovative brewing methods, ensuring every cup meets our high standards.

Warm Atmosphere

Our café is designed to be a welcoming space where you can relax, work, or connect with others while enjoying your favorite beverage.

What Our Customers Say

"The Rwandan Bourbon coffee is simply exceptional. I come here every morning before work and it's the perfect start to my day. The staff remembers my order and always greets me with a smile."

Alexis N.

Regular Customer

"As a tea enthusiast, I appreciate their extensive selection and knowledgeable staff. Noela helped me discover several new favorites. The chamomile with local honey is my go-to for relaxation."

Marie Claire U.

Tea Lover

"The perfect place to work remotely. Great WiFi, comfortable seating, and amazing coffee. The avocado toast is delicious too! I've recommended this place to all my colleagues."

Eric K.

Digital Nomad

Join Our Community

Subscribe to our newsletter for exclusive offers, new product announcements, and coffee/tea brewing tips.
